automaticEntryExchange.existingChips: add converted chips to existing balance
automaticEntryExchange.currentConstraint: Platform now supports manifest-controlled automatic whole-wallet entry conversion.
requiredBehavior: The platform completes the entry exchange before loading the game iframe or allowing server.open to bootstrap the paid balance.
Determine the player's available red diamonds inside an atomic platform transaction, debit all available diamonds, credit diamonds times 50 chips and credit the game's house wallet.
Use a platform-generated entry identifier as the idempotency key. Retrying the same entry returns its original result.
Zero red diamonds is a successful no-op; preserve existing chips and allow normal game startup.
Author preview does not move red diamonds or paid chips.
Publish the resulting chips and red-diamond balances through the SDK's balance events.

platformGameNotices.currentConstraint: Platform SDK ui.alert is now supported; game uses it only for a new paid manual insufficient-funds attempt.

proposedPayload.dedupeKey: per failed attempt or changed blocking condition

requiredBehavior: Provide an officially supported SDK notice method; do not let games imitate trusted platform transaction confirmations.
Display insufficient funds, session replaced, disconnected and settlement pending as different conditions.
Deduplicate held fire or AUTO attempts and dismiss obsolete notices when the condition clears.
Keep financial changes in the platform ledger; notices do not exchange or award currency.
